verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules are a fair question for an AI inference and training platform, but the evidence documents no general rule or trigger system that lets users define event-based actions. The nearest items are adjacent fixed-purpose controls, which don't count: autoscaling replicas on load targets (docs-61) and billing Auto Reload when the balance runs low (docs-70). The REST API's ability to automate management of models and deployments (docs-69) is a building block, not an event-rule engine.
